remarks: Darien, CT: Welcome to 225 Hoyt St. A blank canvas - a perfect location for those wanting to live a Stamford/New Canaan life and benefit from both Darien schools as well as low taxes! This home is perfect for someone with vision and an eye for customization! The fact that 225 Hoyt St. has been in the same family for 50+ years suggests that the property's well-loved; there's huge potential to make this space your own! The deep lot with nature views adds a lot of charm and serenity, while the possibility of adding accessory dwelling unit is a great option for maximizing space. Being located near Springdale (Stamford) allows plenty of conveniences with the diner, post office, shops, restaurants & railroad being walkable! New Canaan boutiques, parks and gourmet restaurants are a 10 minute drive. Holmes Elementary, Middlesex Middle and Darien High School await: Opportunity knocks! Wow! Oh Wow! The good life, indeed! 225 Hoyt is being Sold "AS IS". Previous Buyer was not able to perform. Please no touring grounds or property without a confirmed appointment: Video surveillance throughout! Thank you!
